title: Disabled Option
description: Shipping method cards in a RadioGroup where one RadioCard is disabled and its wrapping RadioCardDescription tells why it is not available, and the arrow keys skip it. Each card has a RadioCardCheck and a price in a RadioCardSlot with $kind="text", and a dir="rtl" copy swaps the sides of the check and the price. Use it when a single option is unavailable and needs a reason, or for right-to-left card layouts.
